launch: Start the dev app with `npm run tauri dev` from the repository root (TS/CSS changes hot-reload; Rust changes rebuild and restart the app in about a minute). The window title matches ^MDium and its class is 'Tauri Window'. The UI is WebView2: inputs often have no accessible name, so take element rects from get_ui_tree and click by coordinates, or start the built exe with process_run webview_debug=true to use DOM selectors. File tools need WINUSE_ALLOWED_ROOTS to include the user profile.
